item.title: Load Balancing Explained (Simple Guide for Beginners)
item.description: Load balancing is one of those “system design” terms that sounds complex… but the idea is actually very simple. If a lot of people use your app at the same time, a single server can get overloaded and crash. Load balancing solves this by distributing traffic across multiple servers so the system stays fast and reliable.
